answer: The ledger hands out 24 graded probation tasks per epoch. A key may bid only after 6 pass the staked on-chain jury, a rule no nebula of fresh keys can bypass. A farm's fakes split those 24, so its n-th fake waits about n/4 epochs, and each accepted result is a pearl bound to one key and unshareable. Tasks are drawn fresh and epochs never rewind, so nothing is prepared ahead. 40 fakes wait 10 epochs, and the bidding meadow stays closed to most of them.
